## Dropped like a housefly

Insects with an appetite for your herd and bottom line don’t stand a chance against our
best-in-class portfolio of insect control products. There are proven Elanco products for every
threat: pour-ons, sprays, dust, baits and more.
[Buy now][22]

## Don’t gamble with respiratory disease

[Bet on gold][23]

## Prevent New World screwworm

When new threats emerge, trusted protection matters. Start your defense against New World screwworm
here.
[Learn more][24]

## Fly season starts now – be ready with Prozap

Stop infestations before they start with trusted fly control products that work as hard as you do.
[Shop now][25]

## Where reproductive precision drives results

Built for the work. Proven where it matters.
GONAbreed + mySYNCH = Where reproductive precision meets consistent execution.
 
[Purchase GONAbreed now][26]

## This isn’t just another teat dip

Resiclean Teat Dip delivers performance, protection and care, all in one. A revolutionary clean for
a new era of udder health.
[Discover Resiclean][27]

## Work with the premier animal health distributor

Whether you’re a producer, veterinarian or retailer, our dedicated representatives work to ensure
that you get the products, solutions and technologies you need, when you need them. We currently
employ more than 320 knowledgeable sales representatives and support staff throughout the U.S., and
are the only all-species, all-channel distributor of animal health products.

Online ordering is available for current Animal Health International customers. If you are not an
Animal Health International customer, but are interested in becoming one, please [contact us][28].
 
[Shop products][29] [Register for online ordering if you’re a customer >][30]

## Trusted products, technologies and support for your operation

Producers look to us for solid solutions that keep their animals healthy and businesses strong. Our
territory representatives have extensive industry knowledge and a passion for helping you. Look to
us for:
* Unbiased guidance on products, technologies and services

* Industry-leading cattle management software

[Explore our producer offerings ][32]
[ [Veterinarian in a dairy barn] ][33]

## Solutions for large animal and mixed practice veterinarians

Whether you’re in the field, in a veterinary clinic or at a production facility, our teams are here
to help. We offer a full range of products, equipment, technology and services for livestock, horses
and companion animals.
[Shop products][34] [Learn about our services][35]
[ [Animal Health International retailer helping a customer] ][36]

## Supplying ag retailers and dealer stores

We provide a wide range of products and an exclusive private label selection that allow you to
maintain stock of items your customers need. Our conveniently located distribution centers allow us
to quickly ship items to you throughout the week and keep your shelves full.

PRODUCTS

#### Our Products

Merck Animal Health is committed to protecting the health of animals and supporting a safe and
affordable food supply.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][216]
[[icon: arrow-right]][217]

Research Innovation

#### Biopharma Research

Healthy animals are the foundation of a healthy world. As threats to animal health evolve, so do our
solutions.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][218]
[[icon: arrow-right]][219]

ABOUT US

#### Our Responsibility

At Merck Animal Health, we believe our responsibilities to wider society extend beyond our primary
goals as a business. 

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][220]

### Our mission is The Science of Healthier Animals. Our science supports the precious bond between
### people and their pets. It also helps protect international public health, ensure food safety and
### increase protein supplies.

[Learn More][221]
[[icon: arrow-right]][222]

## Our Products

Through our broad portfolio of vaccines, therapeutic medicines, parasiticides, and technology
solutions, we help veterinarians, pet owners, farmers, and producers maintain and improve the health
of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][223]

#### Companion Animal

State-of-the-art products and services that help pets live longer, healthier lives.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][224]

#### Equine

Solutions that help maintain and improve the health and welfare of horses.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][225]

#### Swine

Differentiated health solutions focused on improving swine health and farm sustainability.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][226]

#### Ruminants

Pioneering medicines, vaccines, technology, and insights-driven solutions that aim to improve the
health and well-being of ruminants, enable a sustainable meat and dairy supply, and protect public
health.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][227]

#### Poultry

Innovative products and solutions that make a difference, improving poultry health, welfare, and
productivity.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][228]

#### Aqua

Industry-leading biopharmaceutical and technology solutions that ensure the health, welfare and
sustainability of aquatic species. 

[[icon: arrow-right] ][229]

### Research and Innovation

At Merck Animal Health, our scientists and experts are constantly searching for ways to advance the
state of veterinary medicine and animal health through the discovery and development of innovative
products and solutions, including veterinary medicines, vaccines and technology that improve the
health and well-being of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]][230]

## News and Insights

Read our latest news, announcements and resources.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][231]

#### Impact of animal health innovation

Animal health rarely makes national headlines, unless a disease outbreak compels it into the
spotlight. When our agricultural and veterinary systems work as they should, they’re easily taken
for granted.

# Veterinary
# Practice Partners

Keeping veterinary medicine in the hands of veterinary professionals.

## Unleash Your Potential

VPP is a community-driven practice partnership group offering the industry’s only true co-ownership
model. This vet-first organization provides industry-leading support, strategies and resources,
while promoting clinical autonomy and celebrating the distinct identity, culture and legacy of each
hospital in its partnership network.

[Partner With Us][13]

## What Partnership Means to Us

Our doctor partners don’t sell their practices — they co-own them with VPP.  By offering a true
partnership model, VPP enables veterinarians to retain clinical autonomy and brand identity while
gaining the operational and strategic support to reach their potential. VPP is also committed to the
success of veterinarians by offering multiple pathways to partnership through tailored co-ownership
opportunities.

[Partner With Us][14]
[Doctor]

"I am so glad that I chose to partner with VPP. With the support from VPP, my practices are
achieving the goals I had worked toward but that eluded me. We are practicing our best medicine &
care, we are communicating as a team, we are growing the clinics and seeing more pets.
For years, my goal was to open a third hospital. I just could not do it with all the other demands
for my time. Now within my first year of partnership, together we have acquired the practice I had
dreamed of. Currently, we are renovating so that it can open in a few months. The VPP team are 100%
rockstars! Every one of them is committed to helping my clinics and team grow and succeed."

- Dr. R. Reed Stevens

Ellicott Street Animal Hospital, West Side Pet Clinic, and North Buffalo Animal Hospital

[Doctor]

"In one swift move, I secured my future (retirement) , my present (my income) and my dreams: to
partner with people whom I trust while enjoying working with every day, so we can flourish together.
Just please don’t tell them that I got the best part of the bargain: to practice the absolute best
medicine I can and let them do the rest."

- Dr. Ohad Barnea

Tenafly Veterinary Center and Overpeck Creek Animal Hospital

[Doctor]

"I partnered with VPP because I love seeing patients, and want to focus as much of my professional
time on patient care while having a partner to support the rest of the business needs."

- Dr. Stephanie Liff

Pure Paws Veterinary Care

national resources and support to ensure continued high-quality patient care.

# Veterinary
# Practice Partners

Keeping veterinary medicine in the hands of veterinary professionals.

## Unleash Your Potential

VPP is a community-driven practice partnership group offering the industry’s only true co-ownership
model. This vet-first organization provides industry-leading support, strategies and resources,
while promoting clinical autonomy and celebrating the distinct identity, culture and legacy of each
hospital in its partnership network.

[Partner With Us][13]

## What Partnership Means to Us

Our doctor partners don’t sell their practices — they co-own them with VPP.  By offering a true
partnership model, VPP enables veterinarians to retain clinical autonomy and brand identity while
gaining the operational and strategic support to reach their potential. VPP is also committed to the
success of veterinarians by offering multiple pathways to partnership through tailored co-ownership
opportunities.

[Partner With Us][14]
[Doctor]

"I am so glad that I chose to partner with VPP. With the support from VPP, my practices are
achieving the goals I had worked toward but that eluded me. We are practicing our best medicine &
care, we are communicating as a team, we are growing the clinics and seeing more pets.
For years, my goal was to open a third hospital. I just could not do it with all the other demands
for my time. Now within my first year of partnership, together we have acquired the practice I had
dreamed of. Currently, we are renovating so that it can open in a few months. The VPP team are 100%
rockstars! Every one of them is committed to helping my clinics and team grow and succeed."

- Dr. R. Reed Stevens

Ellicott Street Animal Hospital, West Side Pet Clinic, and North Buffalo Animal Hospital

[Doctor]

"In one swift move, I secured my future (retirement) , my present (my income) and my dreams: to
partner with people whom I trust while enjoying working with every day, so we can flourish together.
Just please don’t tell them that I got the best part of the bargain: to practice the absolute best
medicine I can and let them do the rest."

- Dr. Ohad Barnea

Tenafly Veterinary Center and Overpeck Creek Animal Hospital

[Doctor]

"I partnered with VPP because I love seeing patients, and want to focus as much of my professional
time on patient care while having a partner to support the rest of the business needs."

- Dr. Stephanie Liff

Pure Paws Veterinary Care

# Prescription Management

Managing a profitable practice is harder than ever. With 70% of pet parents purchasing online at
least once a week,¹ offering a full-service online pharmacy with home delivery and pet-friendly
compounded medications can keep clients engaged with your practice and drive increased revenue.
[Close up of a dog reaching for a treat]
[Covetrus software interface for Create a Prescription]

## Nurture healthy pets while improving your practice. It’s a win-win

Our online pharmacy solutions with home delivery streamline prescription management, build stronger
client relationships, and contribute to your bottom line. Plus, our compounding services can help
you deliver personalized medicine to the animals in your care, reducing stress for both pets and pet
owners and increasing compliance.

 

Implement our online pharmacy solution as a standalone offering. Or, the Covetrus® Platform can
unlock a holistic approach, integrating pharmacy workflows into additional touchpoints across your
practice.

[Request demo][112] [ Explore Covetrus Platform ][113]

## Our prescription management solutions

### Our online pharmacy solutions build stronger patient relationships and drive revenue.

[
[Covetrus Payments logo]

treatment compliance, and generates practice revenue.

][114] [
[Covetrus Compounding logo]

Deliver personalized care with pet-friendly compounded medication customized by dosage, strength,
form, and flavor.

][115]

Why choose Covetrus^{®}

## We’re champions for vets like you

You became a veterinarian to care for animals and make a difference in their lives. But the daily
grind of running a practice can take its toll. That’s why our mission is to support you with the
products, technology, and services you need to thrive.

 

Because when vets are at their best, pets get the best care.

Managing a profitable practice is harder than ever. With 70% of pet parents purchasing online at

compounded medications can keep clients engaged with your practice and drive increased revenue.
[Close up of a dog reaching for a treat]
[Covetrus software interface for Create a Prescription]

## Nurture healthy pets while improving your practice. It’s a win-win

Our online pharmacy solutions with home delivery streamline prescription management, build stronger
client relationships, and contribute to your bottom line. Plus, our compounding services can help
you deliver personalized medicine to the animals in your care, reducing stress for both pets and pet
owners and increasing compliance.

 

Implement our online pharmacy solution as a standalone offering. Or, the Covetrus® Platform can
unlock a holistic approach, integrating pharmacy workflows into additional touchpoints across your
practice.

You became a veterinarian to care for animals and make a difference in their lives. But the daily

products, technology, and services you need to thrive.

 

Because when vets are at their best, pets get the best care.

Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

# Purpose

We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our
singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are
helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This
commitment defines us as colleagues and as a business.

[Learn More][113]
[Close-up of an automated lab pipetting instrument dispensing into tubes, with a Zoetis researcher
in a lab coat blurred in the background holding a clipboard - Zoetis]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]
[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and
smile near a large window - Zoetis]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]

animals and the people who care for them.

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.  

Guided by our vision to be the most trusted and valued animal health company, Zoetis is committed to
setting new standards for the future of animal care through innovation, customer obsession, and
purpose-driven colleagues.

## [Florida Woodpeckers: Photos & Identification Guide to Common Species][65]

May 30, 2026
[ [Florida Woodpeckers][Florida Woodpeckers] ][66]

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

Each species is described with a focus on identification features and natural history to assist
birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

[Read more][67]

Categories [Animal Lists][68], [Birds][69]

## [Florida Woodpeckers: Photos & Identification Guide to Common Species][65]

May 30, 2026
[ [Florida Woodpeckers][Florida Woodpeckers] ][66]

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

Each species is described with a focus on identification features and natural history to assist
birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

FAQ

## Common questions, straight answers.

What is BeefMaps.com?expand_more

BeefMaps.com is an interactive map that helps you find Rancher Direct Certified independent ranchers
selling beef, custom cuts, and other products straight from the farm — bypassing big meatpackers
entirely.

What does Rancher Direct Certified mean?expand_more

Rancher Direct Certified identifies independent family ranchers who sell beef directly to consumers
with full transparency on sourcing and practices. No middlemen, no mystery.

How do I find beef near me?expand_more

Zoom into your area on the interactive map at beefmaps.com to see nearby Rancher Direct Certified
producers. You can filter by breed, management practice, shipping availability, and more.

Why use BeefMaps instead of grocery store beef?expand_more

BeefMaps connects you directly to ranchers, giving you full transparency on how your beef was raised
and supporting independent family operations amid industry consolidation.

Discover Ceva

At Ceva Animal Health, its our mission to provide innovative health solutions for all animals to
ensure the highest level of care and well-being.

Ceva strives daily to bring to life its vision as a One Health company: “Together, beyond animal
health.”

[ Learn more about Ceva Group ][64]
[Ceva new headquarters in Libourne, France]

Our Portfolio

We drive innovative health solutions for America’s Companion Animals, Poultry and Swine. We strive
to be more than just a company committed to animal health, but a One Health company that plays an
essential role in preserving the health of America’s Companion Animals, Poultry and Swine.

 

[Woman in park with chocolate labrador retriever]

Driving Innovation

We innovate not only in animal health products, but also in industrial production, equipping our
sites with smart technologies. We develop solutions that meet the specific needs of each species,
paying particular attention to their well-being, behavior, and infectious diseases.

[ About Ceva’s approach to innovation ][65]

Our commitment to veterinary excellence sets us apart. As a division of Enovis™ Corporation, we bring forward a synergy of medical technology and veterinary science. Our products are crafted by veterinarians and leading engineers, ensuring that every solution from laser therapies to regenerative medicine is evidence-based, effective, and tailored to support your practice's growth. With Companion Animal Health, you're choosing a partner dedicated to the future of animal healthcare. ##### Why is Evidence-Based Technology Critical in Veterinary Practices? Evidence-based technology is the cornerstone of effective veterinary care. It ensures that the treatments and therapies you provide are supported by solid scientific research, leading to better health outcomes for your patients. Companion Animal Health's product portfolio is grounded in rigorous research and proven results, giving veterinarians the confidence to offer the best care possible. ##### How Does Companion Enhance the Well-being of Animals? At Companion Animal Health, we believe in enhancing animal well-being by providing advanced, non-invasive treatments that promote faster healing and pain relief. Our solutions like PRP and Stem Cell Therapy harness the body's natural healing mechanisms, offering a drug-free approach to managing acute and chronic conditions. By prioritizing the patient's own cells for regeneration, we ensure a kinder, more natural path to recovery. Companion Animal Vaccines: Virbac’s Expertise Comes to Improve

2026/07/16 - Animal health

Virbac has partnered with Improve Veterinary Education to launch an exclusive online training course
dedicated to companion animal vaccination. Designed by experts, this state-of-the-art program
provides European veterinarians with clinical and practical insights that can be applied immediately
in the consultation room. The goal? To better protect animals through the latest best practices
while making daily clinical life easier.

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

At the nexus of trust and tradition, we are not just your generic pharmaceutical distributors, but

#### Valuable Industry Experience

Your business deserves expert guidance, and our sales representatives bring unmatched industry
expertise of 30+ years to the table. They manage your account while ensuring you receive tailored
advice and support backed by deep knowledge and understanding of the pharmaceutical distribution
industry.


#### 2000+ SKUs

As seasoned generic pharmaceutical distributors, our vast inventory includes over 2,000 SKUs,
allowing us to supply a comprehensive range of pharmaceutical formulations to support your
pharmacy’s operational requirements. From widely used generics to specialized therapies, our
exhaustive portfolio keeps your shelves stocked and compliant.

With our extensive nationwide distribution network and license to operate in all 50 states, we
ensure timely and compliant deliveries, reducing wait times and helping you maintain optimal
inventory levels. Our logistical capabilities mean we are always ready to ship directly to your
establishment.


#### Best Pricing in the Industry

Our commitment to affordability is unwavering. We leverage long-standing manufacturer partnerships
and bulk procurement strength to deliver competitive pricing at scale. Every purchase aligns with
our promise of compliance, reliability, and consistent quality—helping healthcare providers maintain
cost efficiency without compromise.


#### Commitment to Innovation

By investing in advanced technology, Drugzone streamlines ordering, tracking, and compliance.
Healthcare partners—from specialty clinics to hospital chains—benefit from secure, efficient, and
transparent operations. Our integrated ERP and compliance monitoring systems enhance real-time
visibility, inventory accuracy, and traceability throughout the supply chain.


#### Partner-Centric Approach

Long-term relationships drive our success. Drugzone works closely with hospitals, LTC providers, and
specialty networks—listening to their needs and delivering solutions that help them serve their
patients better. Our dedicated account managers provide personalized support, ensuring every partner
experiences responsive communication, consistent supply, and measurable value from our
collaboration.

## Comprehensive Distribution Capabilities

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

### Wholesale& Specialty Distribution

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers
across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

### Logistics& Warehousing

State-of-the-art warehouses and a nationwide delivery network ensure secure storage and timely
shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

### Provider& Pharmacy Solutions

Tailored support for diverse healthcare partners and specialty distributors to simplify procurement
and maintain an uninterrupted treatment supply.

### Compliance& Quality Assurance

We ensure full adherence to NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 guidelines. Every shipment undergoes stringent
checks to ensure healthcare providers—across human and animal health—receive authentic and traceable
products.

Strategic Manufacturer Partnerships

## Trusted Partnerships, Reliable Supply

Drugzone strengthens its nationwide supply reliability through long-standing partnerships with
leading generic manufacturers. These strategic alliances ensure verified authenticity, stable
pricing, and consistent access to essential medications across multiple therapeutic areas.

[img]

### Direct Sourcing

Direct sourcing from trusted and approved manufacturers ensures product integrity and verified
traceability.

[img]

### 75+ Manufacturer Network

Partnered with 75+ leading generic manufacturers across the U.S. and global markets.

[img]

### Verified Authenticity

Every product undergoes multi-step verification and documentation to confirm authenticity before
distribution.

[img]

## Human & Animal Health

At Drugzone, equal commitment is given to human and animal health, ensuring safe, compliant, and
reliable access to quality pharmaceuticals across the U.S. under NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025
standards.

[img]

## Human Health

Drugzone supports healthcare facilities nationwide with access to safe, cost-effective generic
formulations. Each product is stored and distributed following the strictest compliance standards.

[img]

### Comprehensive Product Range

A broad portfolio of quality-assured generic pharmaceuticals designed to support hospitals, LTC
networks, and specialty care facilities.

[img]

### Hospital& Specialty Pharmacy Support

Reliable distribution designed to help hospitals and specialty networks maintain consistent
treatment availability.

[img]

### Regulatory Compliance

Strict adherence to NABP and FDA guidelines, ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable delivery of
human health products.

[Know more][20]

## Animal Health

Drugzone extends its trusted distribution network to veterinary hospitals, clinics, and animal care
providers, ensuring consistent access to essential products.

[img]

### Veterinary Product Lines

Dedicated pharmaceutical solutions designed for veterinarians, clinics, and animal healthcare
facilities.

[img]

### Specialty Formulations

Sutures, oncology formulations, and generic alternatives tailored for animal health practices.

[img]

### Trusted Distribution

Compliant with all state and federal regulations to guarantee authentic, traceable supply for animal
care providers.

[Know more][21]
[img]

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

## Licensed in All 50 States

With FDA registration and DSCSA 2025 readiness, our 50-state licensing ensures healthcare providers
across the U.S. receive authentic, safe, and timely pharmaceutical supply.

[img]

## OUR PARTNERS

We work with companies and manufacturers worldwide.

# Home Page

December 4, 2018 by [foxsa][56]

# Animals Need You.
# You Need Data.

Faunalytics conducts research and shares knowledge to help advocates help animals effectively.

AllAnimals Used for FoodAnimals Used in ScienceCompanion AnimalsEffective AdvocacyOther TopicsOur
BlogWild Animals

## Research Highlights

Faunalytics’ studies offer actionable and insightful data on important topics in animal protection

[
[veggie stew indian]
][57]

### [ The Multi-Generational Kitchen: How To Market Plant-Based Eating To Indian Gen Z Households
### ][58]

Jun 24 2026 [Andrea Polanco][59]
Faunalytics surveyed hundreds of Indian Gen Z adults, asking about household food dynamics, food
choice motivations, familiarity with plant-based products, and barriers to plant-based eating. Our
report offers practical guidance for animal advocates and alternative protein companies in the
region. [READ MORE][60]
[
[veggie stew indian]
][61]

### [ The Multi-Generational Kitchen: How To Market Plant-Based Eating To Indian Gen Z Households
### ][62]

Faunalytics surveyed hundreds of Indian Gen Z adults, asking about household food dynamics, food
choice motivations, familiarity with plant-based products, and barriers to plant-based eating. Our
report offers practical guidance for animal advocates and alternative protein companies in the
region. [READ MORE][63]
Jun 24 2026 [Andrea Polanco][64]

In the Spotlight

[
[noodles and tofu]
][65]

### [ The Aspirational Plate: Mapping The Gap Between Vegan & Vegetarian Identity And Global
### Behavior ][66]

Through a systematic review of 837 nationally representative sources, this Faunalytics study
investigates dietary rates across 58 countries over 10 years, examining the gap between veg*n
identity and global behavior. We provide advocates and researchers with insights and recommendations
for how to approach this gap and the challenges it creates for our global movement. [READ MORE][67]
Apr 29 2026 [Elise Hankins][68]
[
[young pig in factory farm]
][69]

### [ Are Welfare Laws Reshaping U.S. Animal Product Production And Trade? ][70]

Faunalytics examines USDA data to understand whether state-level animal welfare laws and sales bans
— particularly California’s Proposition 12 — are reshaping where U.S. animal products are produced,
consumed, and exported. [READ MORE][71]
Mar 11 2026 [karol orzechowski][72]
[
[indian spice array]
][73]

### [ Food Systems Advocacy In The Global South: A Framework And Pilot In India ][74]

Across the animal advocacy movement, there’s growing recognition that a strategy’s success is
closely tied to the environment in which it’s implemented. This pilot study proposes a practical
framework for India that supports advocates and funders to design, adapt, and evaluate campaigns
under India’s contextual realities. With feedback from other advocates in the Global South, this
framework can be refined and adapted to other contexts in the future. [READ MORE][75]
Feb 25 2026 [Anita Rajan][76]
[

* Andrea Polanco

Through a systematic review of 837 nationally representative sources, this Faunalytics study

In the Spotlight

* karol orzechowski

### Are Welfare Laws Reshaping U.S. Animal Product Production And Trade?

Faunalytics examines USDA data to understand whether state-level animal welfare laws and sales bans
— particularly California’s Proposition 12 — are reshaping where U.S. animal products are produced,
consumed, and exported.

In the Spotlight

][79]
[
[indian spice array]
* February 25, 2026
* Anita Rajan

### Food Systems Advocacy In The Global South: A Framework And Pilot In India

Across the animal advocacy movement, there’s growing recognition that a strategy’s success is
closely tied to the environment in which it’s implemented. This pilot study proposes a practical
framework for India that supports advocates and funders to design, adapt, and evaluate campaigns
under India’s contextual realities. With feedback from other advocates in the Global South, this
framework can be refined and adapted to other contexts in the future.

In the Spotlight

][80]
[ view all research projects ][81]

## New From Our Library

The latest research to help make your animal advocacy more effective

[
[pigs looking crowded and dirty in indoor pen]
* July 24, 2026
* Mona Zahir

### The Limited Power Of Farmed Animal Welfare Inspectors

Across the European Union, expert veterinarians are sent out to ensure that farms and
slaughterhouses do the bare minimum. And sometimes, even minimal welfare is too high a bar where
economics is concerned.

In the Spotlight

][82]
[
[hands holding coins and make a change sign]
* July 23, 2026
* Meghann Cant

### Do Donors Give With Their Hearts Or Their Heads?

Two large meta-analyses find that while people believe they give based on effectiveness, empathy is
the more reliable driver of charitable giving.

In the Spotlight

][83]
[
[we hear you poster]
* July 22, 2026
* Allison Troy

### Faunalytics’ 2026 Community Survey Results

The yearly results are in! We present the findings from our annual Community Survey, including what
you think we’re doing right, what we can do better, and our plans for the future.

In the Spotlight

][84]
[
[pair of sulphur-crested cockatoos cuddling in tree Australia]
* July 21, 2026
* Meghann Cant

### Exotic Birds Suffer Serious Welfare Risks In Captivity

Experts assessed 27 parrot and toucan species and found that achieving good welfare for any of these
birds in private homes is extremely challenging.

In the Spotlight

][85]
[
[neon sign with cartoon pig pure pork sausage]
* July 20, 2026
* Flavia Manieri

### If Your Dinner Could Smile, Would You Still Eat It?

Most people rarely think about the animals behind the meat on their plates. But what happens when
this psychological distance is reduced?

In the Spotlight

][86]
[
[serval lying on ground surrounded by ivy]
* July 17, 2026
* Robert Davy

### The Global Wildlife Trade Drives Animal-To-Human Disease Transmission

Analysis of 40 years of global wildlife trade data shows that traded mammal species are much more
likely to share pathogens with humans than non-traded ones.

In the Spotlight

][87]
[
[black mouse climbing out of open laboratory cage]
* July 16, 2026
* Meghann Cant

### Laboratory Rodents Deserve Better Than Improvised Killing Methods

Cervical dislocation is the most common killing method for mice and rats in U.K. laboratories. Yet
it’s applied inconsistently, often with improvised tools, raising serious animal welfare concerns.

In the Spotlight

][88]
[
[road symbolizing progress]
* July 15, 2026
* Brooke Haggerty

### Faunalytics’ 2026 Mid-Year Review: What We’ve Built For The Movement & What We Have In Store

We’re sharing a mid-year update full of momentum: new global research, the launch of the Faunalytics
Lens AI-powered tool, and real evidence that our work is shaping advocacy strategies worldwide.
Plus, we give a glimpse of what’s next.

In the Spotlight

][89]
[
[eat veg spelled out in peas on wooden table]
* July 14, 2026
* Elena Schaller

### Why Some People Stick With Meat Free Monday And Others Don’t

People who successfully follow through with meat reduction campaigns are more than just motivated.
They’re supported by their identity, social environment, and access to practical tools like
meat-free recipes.

In the Spotlight

][90]
[
[close-up of grey cat with yellow eyes staring out from black metal cage]
* July 13, 2026
* Tamara Kedves

### Data Reveals What Animal Control Officers Really Do

An analysis of national field services data, the first of its kind, sheds light on how animal
control officers spend their time, and how often education and support outweigh enforcement.

In the Spotlight

### [ The Aspirational Plate: Mapping The Gap Between Vegan & Vegetarian Identity And Global
### Behavior ][66]

Through a systematic review of 837 nationally representative sources, this Faunalytics study
investigates dietary rates across 58 countries over 10 years, examining the gap between veg*n
identity and global behavior. We provide advocates and researchers with insights and recommendations
for how to approach this gap and the challenges it creates for our global movement. [READ MORE][67]
Apr 29 2026 [Elise Hankins][68]

[young pig in factory farm]
][69]

### [ Are Welfare Laws Reshaping U.S. Animal Product Production And Trade? ][70]

Faunalytics examines USDA data to understand whether state-level animal welfare laws and sales bans
— particularly California’s Proposition 12 — are reshaping where U.S. animal products are produced,
consumed, and exported. [READ MORE][71]
Mar 11 2026 [karol orzechowski][72]
[
[indian spice array]
][73]

### [ Food Systems Advocacy In The Global South: A Framework And Pilot In India ][74]

Across the animal advocacy movement, there’s growing recognition that a strategy’s success is
closely tied to the environment in which it’s implemented. This pilot study proposes a practical
framework for India that supports advocates and funders to design, adapt, and evaluate campaigns
under India’s contextual realities. With feedback from other advocates in the Global South, this
framework can be refined and adapted to other contexts in the future. [READ MORE][75]
Feb 25 2026 [Anita Rajan][76]

likely to share pathogens with humans than non-traded ones.

### Laboratory Rodents Deserve Better Than Improvised Killing Methods

Cervical dislocation is the most common killing method for mice and rats in U.K. laboratories. Yet
it’s applied inconsistently, often with improvised tools, raising serious animal welfare concerns.

# Golden is now part of *ComplyAdvantage.*

We set out to build a self-constructing knowledge graph of the world's information. In 2024, that
technology found its home inside ComplyAdvantage — powering financial crime intelligence for over
1,000 enterprises.

2017
Founded
$59.5M
Raised
a16z
Lead backer
2024
Acquired
SF
Headquarters
The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

[GOLDEN.com][6]

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

PRODUCTS

## Our Products

MSD Animal Health is committed to protecting the health of animals and supporting a safe and
affordable food supply.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][208]
[[icon: arrow-right]][209]

Research Innovation

## Biopharma Research

Healthy animals are the foundation of a healthy world. As threats to animal health evolve, so do our
solutions.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][210]
[[icon: arrow-right]][211]

ABOUT US

## Our Responsibility

At MSD Animal Health, we believe our responsibilities to wider society extend beyond our primary
goals as a business. 

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][212]

## Our mission is The Science of Healthier Animals. Our science supports the precious bond between
## people and their pets. It also helps protect international public health, ensure food safety and
## increase protein supplies.

[Learn More][213]
[[icon: arrow-right]][214]

## Our Products

Through our broad portfolio of vaccines, therapeutic medicines, parasiticides, and technology
solutions, we help veterinarians, pet owners, farmers, and producers maintain and improve the health
of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][215]

### Companion Animal

State-of-the-art products and services that help pets live longer, healthier lives.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][216]

### Equine

Solutions that help maintain and improve the health and welfare of horses.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][217]

### Swine

Differentiated health solutions focused on improving swine health and farm sustainability.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][218]

### Ruminants

Pioneering medicines, vaccines, technology, and insights-driven solutions that aim to improve the
health and well-being of ruminants, enable a sustainable meat and dairy supply, and protect public
health.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][219]

### Poultry

Innovative products and solutions that make a difference, improving poultry health, welfare, and
productivity.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][220]

### Aqua

Industry-leading biopharmaceutical and technology solutions that ensure the health, welfare and
sustainability of aquatic species. 

[[icon: arrow-right] ][221]

## Research and Innovation

At MSD Animal Health, our scientists and experts are constantly searching for ways to advance the
state of veterinary medicine and animal health through the discovery and development of innovative
products and solutions, including veterinary medicines, vaccines and technology that improve the
health and well-being of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]][222]

## News and Insights

Read our latest news, announcements and resources.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][223]

### New Global Survey Shows Itch is Taking a Toll on Pets, Owners and Vets

A new global survey, “Pet Owner and Vet Perspectives on Canine Pruritus,” reveals that itchy skin
and allergic skin disease are among the most common reasons dogs visit the veterinarian. About one
in three canine patients in the U.S. (and more than one in four worldwide) are seen for itchy skin
or allergic skin disease, and about two in five dogs with skin conditions are newly diagnosed. The
impact extends well beyond the dog: 34% of U.S. dog owners (31% globally) say their dog’s allergic
skin disease significantly affects their own quality of life, and 61% of U.S. owners (60% globally)
have booked vet appointments specifically for their dog’s itchy skin.

[[icon: arrow-right] Read more ][224]

## Our Products

MSD Animal Health is committed to protecting the health of animals and supporting a safe and

Research Innovation

## Biopharma Research

Healthy animals are the foundation of a healthy world. As threats to animal health evolve, so do our
solutions.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][210]
[[icon: arrow-right]][211]

ABOUT US

## Our Responsibility

At MSD Animal Health, we believe our responsibilities to wider society extend beyond our primary
goals as a business. 

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][212]

## Our mission is The Science of Healthier Animals. Our science supports the precious bond between
## people and their pets. It also helps protect international public health, ensure food safety and
## increase protein supplies.

[Learn More][213]
[[icon: arrow-right]][214]

## Our Products

Through our broad portfolio of vaccines, therapeutic medicines, parasiticides, and technology
solutions, we help veterinarians, pet owners, farmers, and producers maintain and improve the health
of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][215]

### Companion Animal

State-of-the-art products and services that help pets live longer, healthier lives.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][216]

### Equine

Solutions that help maintain and improve the health and welfare of horses.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][217]

### Swine

Differentiated health solutions focused on improving swine health and farm sustainability.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][218]

### Ruminants

Pioneering medicines, vaccines, technology, and insights-driven solutions that aim to improve the
health and well-being of ruminants, enable a sustainable meat and dairy supply, and protect public
health.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][219]

### Poultry

Innovative products and solutions that make a difference, improving poultry health, welfare, and
productivity.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][220]

### Aqua

Industry-leading biopharmaceutical and technology solutions that ensure the health, welfare and
sustainability of aquatic species. 

[[icon: arrow-right] ][221]

## Research and Innovation

At MSD Animal Health, our scientists and experts are constantly searching for ways to advance the
state of veterinary medicine and animal health through the discovery and development of innovative
products and solutions, including veterinary medicines, vaccines and technology that improve the
health and well-being of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]][222]

## News and Insights

Read our latest news, announcements and resources.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][223]

### New Global Survey Shows Itch is Taking a Toll on Pets, Owners and Vets

A new global survey, “Pet Owner and Vet Perspectives on Canine Pruritus,” reveals that itchy skin
and allergic skin disease are among the most common reasons dogs visit the veterinarian. About one
in three canine patients in the U.S. (and more than one in four worldwide) are seen for itchy skin
or allergic skin disease, and about two in five dogs with skin conditions are newly diagnosed. The
impact extends well beyond the dog: 34% of U.S. dog owners (31% globally) say their dog’s allergic
skin disease significantly affects their own quality of life, and 61% of U.S. owners (60% globally)
have booked vet appointments specifically for their dog’s itchy skin.

## Leader in Veterinary Compounding

NexGen Pharmaceuticals is an industry leader in the veterinary
compounding marketplace. We're committed to producing the
highest quality compounds along with unparalleled customer
service.

We strive to have the most innovative product lines and to
consistently improve our process through the implementation
of the latest available technology.

Read more

### Veterinary Compounding Pharmacy

Unlike other veterinary compounding pharmacies, NexGen focuses on drugs that are difficult to find
or are no longer available due to manufacturer discontinuance or have yet to be offered commercially
for veterinary applications, but which still serve a critical need for our customers.

NexGen also specializes in wildlife pharmaceuticals, including sedatives and their antagonists,
offering many unique options to serve a wide array of zoo animal and wildlife immobilization and
anesthesia requirements.

### Our Veterinary Pharmacists

The role of the NexGen veterinary pharmacist is an extremely important one, not only as it relates
to the industry of veterinary medicine, but to society at large. Our pharmacists are well aware that
they do not simply dispense medications in a pharmacy practice, and that their industry and their
performance impacts many sectors of society, from pet care to public health.

As such, NexGen veterinary pharmacists play a much more important role than that of the pharmacy
technician.

NexGen's veterinary pharmacists are specially-trained professionals who dispense veterinary drugs,
supplies and advice to owners of companion animals, performance animals, as well as non-domestic and
exotic animals. In partnership with our veterinarians, they also advise regulatory bodies and are
involved in the formulation of custom compounded veterinary drugs.

Thus, one can see how this proposition involves much more than a healthy background in pet
medications. While dispensing prescriptions for companion animals is certainly important, the role
of NexGen's veterinary pharmacists encompasses a great deal more.

### The Veterinary Compounding Pharmacy

Consistent with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Extra-Label Drug Use regulations, veterinary
compounding is the customized manipulation of an approved drug(s) by a veterinarian, or by a
pharmacist upon the prescription of a veterinarian, to meet the needs of a particular patient.¹

Within these parameters, NexGen pharmacists formulate (compound) drugs individually and in
combination for optimal efficacy to address common and emerging issues in veterinary medicine.

These include commonly-known medicines, synthetic hormones, novel compounds and controlled
substances. With their experience and knowledge of the challenges common to the veterinary medical
field, our pharmacists are also very well-versed in dosage forms that increase medication adherence
in animals.

## Leader in Veterinary Compounding

NexGen Pharmaceuticals is an industry leader in the veterinary
compounding marketplace. We're committed to producing the
highest quality compounds along with unparalleled customer
service.

We strive to have the most innovative product lines and to
consistently improve our process through the implementation
of the latest available technology.

Read more

### Veterinary Compounding Pharmacy

Unlike other veterinary compounding pharmacies, NexGen focuses on drugs that are difficult to find
or are no longer available due to manufacturer discontinuance or have yet to be offered commercially
for veterinary applications, but which still serve a critical need for our customers.

NexGen also specializes in wildlife pharmaceuticals, including sedatives and their antagonists,
offering many unique options to serve a wide array of zoo animal and wildlife immobilization and
anesthesia requirements.

### Our Veterinary Pharmacists

The role of the NexGen veterinary pharmacist is an extremely important one, not only as it relates
to the industry of veterinary medicine, but to society at large. Our pharmacists are well aware that
they do not simply dispense medications in a pharmacy practice, and that their industry and their
performance impacts many sectors of society, from pet care to public health.

As such, NexGen veterinary pharmacists play a much more important role than that of the pharmacy
technician.

NexGen's veterinary pharmacists are specially-trained professionals who dispense veterinary drugs,
supplies and advice to owners of companion animals, performance animals, as well as non-domestic and
exotic animals. In partnership with our veterinarians, they also advise regulatory bodies and are
involved in the formulation of custom compounded veterinary drugs.

Thus, one can see how this proposition involves much more than a healthy background in pet
medications. While dispensing prescriptions for companion animals is certainly important, the role
of NexGen's veterinary pharmacists encompasses a great deal more.

### The Veterinary Compounding Pharmacy

Consistent with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Extra-Label Drug Use regulations, veterinary
compounding is the customized manipulation of an approved drug(s) by a veterinarian, or by a
pharmacist upon the prescription of a veterinarian, to meet the needs of a particular patient.¹

Within these parameters, NexGen pharmacists formulate (compound) drugs individually and in
combination for optimal efficacy to address common and emerging issues in veterinary medicine.

These include commonly-known medicines, synthetic hormones, novel compounds and controlled
substances. With their experience and knowledge of the challenges common to the veterinary medical
field, our pharmacists are also very well-versed in dosage forms that increase medication adherence
in animals.

# Mastering Global Regulatory Affairs in the Pharmaceutical Industry

## 1. Understanding the Role of Pharma Regulatory Affairs

Pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs is a multidisciplinary function within the pharmaceutical and
biotechnology industries. It plays a critical role in ensuring that all products—drugs, biologics,
and medical devices—comply with the regulations and standards required by regulatory agencies across
various countries. The regulatory affairs department acts as the interface between pharmaceutical
companies and regulatory bodies such as the FDA (United States), EMA (European Union), CDSCO
(India), PMDA (Japan), and TGA (Australia). These agencies are responsible for reviewing and
approving drug applications, overseeing safety reporting, and enforcing post-approval compliance.

At its core, regulatory affairs involves the preparation, compilation, and submission of a wide
range of regulatory documents. These documents include dossiers (CTD/eCTD), product labels, periodic
safety reports, clinical trial applications, and responses to regulatory queries. In addition, the
regulatory team ensures that the company’s products are registered correctly in each market,
labeling is compliant, and pharmacovigilance systems are in place. Regulatory professionals must
stay up to date with evolving legislation and guidance documents, as non-compliance can result in
delayed product approvals, fines, or even market bans.

The scope of regulatory affairs is not limited to product approval. It extends to lifecycle
management, including post-marketing surveillance, renewals, and variations. Companies often rely on
regulatory intelligence to anticipate changes in global legislation and proactively adjust their
strategies. As global markets expand, pharmaceutical companies increasingly need to harmonize their
regulatory strategies across jurisdictions while addressing country-specific requirements. This need
gives rise to regulatory harmonization initiatives like ICH (International Council for
Harmonisation) and WHO’s collaborative registration procedures.

management, including post-marketing surveillance, renewals, and variations. Companies often rely on

strategies. As global markets expand, pharmaceutical companies increasingly need to harmonize their

gives rise to regulatory harmonization initiatives like ICH (International Council for
Harmonisation) and WHO’s collaborative registration procedures.

Ultimately, regulatory affairs ensure that patients have timely access to safe and effective
medications. It helps companies navigate a highly regulated environment, reduce compliance risks,
and bring innovations to market faster. As the regulatory landscape becomes more complex with the
advent of gene therapy, biosimilars, and personalized medicine, the demand for skilled regulatory
professionals continues to rise. For these reasons, pharma regulatory affairs are not just a support
function—they are a strategic pillar of the pharmaceutical business model.

## 2. Key Global Regulatory Authorities and Their Requirements

Pharmaceutical companies operating globally must adhere to regulatory frameworks set by each
country’s competent authority. These agencies oversee the entire lifecycle of pharmaceutical
products—from clinical trials to marketing authorization and post-market surveillance. The major
regulatory bodies include the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), European Medicines Agency
(EMA), Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) in India, the Pharmaceuticals and Medical
Devices Agency (PMDA) in Japan, and the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) in Australia. Each
agency has its own application formats, timelines, electronic submission systems, and regulatory
expectations, making it crucial for regulatory teams to adopt a tailored approach for each region.

The U.S. FDA regulates drugs, biologics, and medical devices through a robust system that includes
pre-IND (Investigational New Drug) meetings, submission of IND applications for clinical trials, and
final approval via NDA (New Drug Application) or BLA (Biologics License Application). The FDA
mandates submission in electronic format via the Electronic Submissions Gateway (ESG) using the eCTD
standard. Additionally, periodic safety reporting, annual updates, and compliance with labeling and
promotional guidelines are essential post-approval obligations.

The EMA functions under the centralized procedure, where a single application leads to marketing
authorization across all EU member states. It also supports decentralized and mutual recognition
procedures (DCP and MRP) for drugs not eligible for centralized review. EMA requires rigorous
compliance with ICH guidelines and regional documentation in Module 1 of the eCTD. Scientific
advice, orphan designation, and accelerated assessment pathways are additional features companies

# Caring for your Beloved Pet is our Passion

Caring for your Beloved Pet is our PassionCaring for your Beloved Pet is our PassionCaring for your
Beloved Pet is our PassionCaring for your Beloved Pet is our Passion
[Please Call Us at 369-8829][2]

#### About Us

#### Compassionate and Personalized Care

**Victor** **Mobile** **Veterinary** serves the local Bitterroot Valley, from Florence to Darby,
treating dogs and cats only. Karl and Lori Anderson have worked together for almost twenty years in
small animal medicine, and now provide At Home Euthanasia services with Victor Mobile Veterinary
Services.

  

Due to overwhelming demand and need, Victor Mobile Veterinary is now focused on At-Home-Euthanasia
as our primary service. Other services considered emergent or routine medical procedures are
recommended to be performed by local veterinary hospitals, as we are no longer providing these
services.



Lori and I have elected to adjust our business in this manner because we feel that this particular
service should be delivered with compassion and sensitivity, and our clients have responded with
such appreciation for our ability to help them in this very difficult period of pet stewardship.





[Find out more][3]

#### Experience

Our story: Karl graduated from UC Davis and he has been a licensed veterinarian since 2001; Lori
attained licensure as a Registered Veterinary Technician in 2017 after working in the field for over
twenty years, and now is also licensed in Montana as a  LVT (aka Licensed Veterinary Technician).
 We owned and managed a popular small animal clinic out of state which we sold in 2021 in order to
relocate here to Montana, our true home. 



#### A Personal Approach

Working with animals is in our DNA. We are confident that once you meet us, you’ll understand that
we are committed to the Veterinarian's Oath, which commits us to prevent and relieve animal
suffering. 

Our goal is to provide a comfortable, anxiety-free passing for your  beloved pet, who we acknowledge
as a valued family member.  

#### Photo Gallery







## Our Blog

#### Contact Us

#### Excellent care for your best friend!

Please call us for an appointment, and leave a message if we don’t answer (it’s just the two of us,
we don’t have a receptionist!).
We will return your call at our earliest convenience.
 

#### Victor Mobile Veterinary

[406-369-8829][4]

#### Hours

Our schedule is generally flexible, and we are usually available between the hours of 8am-5pm on
most weekdays, and Saturdays between 8am-noon, barring other scheduling or personal commitments.

as our primary service. Other services considered emergent or routine medical procedures are
recommended to be performed by local veterinary hospitals, as we are no longer providing these
services.



Lori and I have elected to adjust our business in this manner because we feel that this particular
service should be delivered with compassion and sensitivity, and our clients have responded with
such appreciation for our ability to help them in this very difficult period of pet stewardship.





[Find out more][3]

#### Experience

Our story: Karl graduated from UC Davis and he has been a licensed veterinarian since 2001; Lori
attained licensure as a Registered Veterinary Technician in 2017 after working in the field for over
twenty years, and now is also licensed in Montana as a  LVT (aka Licensed Veterinary Technician).

relocate here to Montana, our true home.

we are committed to the Veterinarian's Oath, which commits us to prevent and relieve animal
suffering.

as a valued family member.

## About WSAVA

The WSAVA is a global community of more than 390,000 veterinarians worldwide drawn from our 113
member associations. Together, we are working to advance the health and welfare of companion animals
throughout the world and to speak on behalf of companion animal veterinarians globally. In support
of our mission our core activities are based around four key pillars:
* The advancement of companion animal welfare.
* The creation of globally relevant ‘Standardization Guidelines’ in key areas of veterinary care.
* The provision of continuing education (CE) for companion animal veterinarians globally
* Increasing understanding of the importance of companion animals in the One Health movement.
